title: MXFP4 for LLM Inference: Complementary Post-Training Quantization Techniques and Their Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2611.32873v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in low-precision representation have introduced several microscaling numerical formats for LLM quantization. By sharing a scale factor across groups of 16 or 32 elements, these formats enable aggressive low-precision quantization with minimal accuracy degradation, particularly when combined with modern PTQ algorithms. Their accuracy depends on how the numerical format interacts with rotation, PTQ, and scale selection. We study the composability of PTQ configurations across six LLMs and three microscaling formats: MXFP6, MXFP4, and NVFP4, systematically varying Hadamard rotation granularity, PTQ algorithm, and scale-selection strategy. Our central finding is that effective quantization recipes are format dependent: both MXFP4 and NVFP4 support accurate 4-bit inference, but techniques that benefit one do not necessarily transfer to the other. tldr: 该研究发现有效的微缩放格式量化方案依赖于具体格式：MXFP4和NVFP4虽都支持精确的4位推理，但MXFP4显著受益于旋转和纠错PTQ技术，而这些技术未必适用于NVFP4。
en_tdlr: Effective quantization recipes for microscaling numerical formats are format-dependent: both MXFP4 and NVFP4 support accurate 4-bit LLM inference, but MXFP4 benefits substantially from rotation and error-correcting PTQ, and techniques that benefit one format do not necessarily transfer to the other.
